text:
Philadelphia arrives on game two of a five-game road trip, three days after a 3-2 loss at the Rangers, and the Flyers are 1-3-1 in their last five without Rasmus Ristolainen. Calgary is two days removed from a 5-3 home loss to Anaheim, which came back from two goals down and won on Cutter Gauthier's goal with 1:34 left. The Flames are missing Connor Zary and Samuel Honzek. It's the first meeting this season; Calgary won both last year.

Our numbers say the Flames are better than their record. At five on five they have 46% of the expected goals (the quality of chances taken and allowed) to Philadelphia's 41%, and their poor results trace to finishing and goaltending. That puts the projected goalies in focus. Dan Vladar is slightly below expected this season but was 12.74 goals saved above expected last year (how many goals a goalie stopped beyond what his shots should have produced). Dustin Wolf is at -6.6 this season and -2.8 last. Our model has it close to even, 2.93 expected goals for the Flyers and 2.90 for the Flames.

Matvei Michkov has 11 points in his last ten games, and we have him at 27% to score. Trevor Zegras is our top Philadelphia pick at 28%. For Calgary, Joel Farabee, a former Flyer, leads at 30%. A deeper pick: we like Flyers fourth-liner Cole Knuble as an under-the-radar player to watch, since his shots have been dangerous (2.2 expected goals in his last 8 games), and we have him at 14% to score.
